mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 5.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which accelerates inflation and prompts aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises simultaneously over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (as indicated by high consumer spending and housing starts), a decline in residential investment (RSAFS) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (relative to 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% year-over-year signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand, which supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST YoY > 10.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.3% over the past 3 months signals an imminent monetary easing cycle, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.3% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 0.5% monthly growth signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.
